Subject: Thornbury Electric - Referral Questions

Hi Tomas,

Thanks for the submission on Thornbury Electric. I've reviewed the information and have everything I need to move forward.

Since this is a contractor risk, I'll need to refer this to our senior underwriter for approval. To help expedite the review, could you please provide answers to the following:

- What types of electrical contracting work does Thornbury Electric perform (residential, commercial, industrial)?
- What is the breakdown of revenue by work type?
- What are their typical project sizes?
- Do they perform any high-hazard work (high voltage, underground, etc.)?

Once I have these details, I'll get this in front of the team right away for the 11/20/26 effective date.

Thanks,
[Underwriter name]
